heroHeadline: President Accuses PM Tusk of Forced Takeover of Poland's Top Court
heroSubtitle: Detained 11 Oct in Lower Silesia, the suspect (Krzysztof N.) was charged on 13 Oct with plotting to overthrow state authorities using explosives, plus online incitement counts. He denies the offences; a custody ruling was due 14 Oct. No foreign link has been reported.
footerNote: Data sourced from official Polish government statements, major international outlets, and institutional analyses.
